description:
Cast Deathbellow War Cry by paying {5}{R}{R}{R}, putting Changeling Berserker, Changeling Hero, and Changeling Titan onto the battlefield.
Changeling Hero, Changeling Titan, and Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield triggers.
Resolve Changeling Hero triggers by championing Changeling Titan.
Resolve Changeling Titan triggers, does nothing.
Resolve Changeling Berserker triggers by championing Changeling Hero.
Changeling Titan enters the battlefield triggers.
Resolve Changeling Titan triggers, championing Changeling Berserker.
Changeling Hero enters the battlefield triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
